petitioner: ADITYA BIRLA FINANCE LTD  AND ANR
operative_text_excerpt:
overruled the Division Bench Judgment of this Court in
Andhra Bank & Ors. vs. Sri Dinesh Kumar Agarwal &
Ors.; (2013)4 CHN 95 on that basis.
WPA 2240 of 2023 is accordingly allowed and
disposed of with a direction on the learned Chief
Judicial Magistrate, Barasat to decide and dispose of
the application within the time frame as provided under
Section 14(1)(9) first and second proviso.  Since the
period envisaged therein has already expired, the
application shall be disposed of within 30 days from the
date of communication of this order.
                             (Moushumi Bhattacharya, J.)
